name: Aurora Isle — site artifact sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Aurora Isle in original map is a cold blue/white floating island with clustered slender spires, crystal/ice-like cliffs and aurora light above. The crop supplies mood and skyline only; no complete floor plan or plant inventory is visible. Hidden layout inference: Make one compact sky arrival court and a sheltered frost garden path to the brightest lookout, with a quiet loop behind low icy outcrops. Retain the cool luminous identity; hidden rooms, warmed garden shelters and rear routes are imagination-based rather than recovered. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "S02-ARTIFACT-001 — Aurora Isle — site artifact sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".
